title: Coast Guard medevacs 4 crewmembers from oil tanker off Vieques, Puerto Rico
description: A U.S. Coast Guard Air Station Borinquen helicopter crew evacuated four mariners suffering from suspected food poisoning  from the Cyprus-flagged oil tanker M/V Daibelli near Vieques, Puerto Rico, Nov. 8, 2026. The four crew members were hoisted aboard an MH-60T Jayhawk helicopter and transported to Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport in San Juan before being taken to a regional hospital for medical care. (U.S. Coast Guard video)
